asset.name: Chrome Theme
asset.description: The single owner of OS status-bar and app-chrome appearance, resolving a priority-ordered set of contributors and writing both the theme-color meta tag and the safe-area strip from one value.

requires.reason: The safe-area strip is sized from the declared safe-area inset tokens rather than raw env() reads.

rationale: The status bar is two platform mechanisms — theme-color on Android, a painted safe-area strip on iOS black-translucent — and any surface that writes only one is correct on one platform and stale on the other. Splitting ownership across surfaces produces the same defect a second way: a notice dismissed by the reader leaves the notch tinted, because the surface that painted it was reading conditions rather than what is on screen.
